zh.title: flyadeal 舉辦塗裝設計競賽慶祝第 50 架客機
zh.summary: flyadeal 邀請大眾為第 50 架客機設計塗裝；優勝者可獲機票與住宿
body: 沙烏地阿拉伯低成本航空 flyadeal 邀請大眾為其第 50 架客機設計塗裝，舉辦一項競賽活動，優勝者可獲得兩人來回機票、三晚住宿，以及讓獲勝設計實際塗裝於飛機上的機會。
競賽透過 flyadeal 專屬網站進行，參賽者須依據航空公司品牌指南創作原創塗裝概念。flyadeal 表示，品牌核心色盤包括 flyadeal Purple、flyadeal Lime、白色、藍色、天藍色與粉紅色。
flyadeal 指出，參賽作品將依原創性、視覺吸引力、品牌相關性與可行性進行評選，由航空公司評審小組作最終決定。flyadeal 另表示，獲獎設計在實際塗裝於飛機前，可能因營運、安全或製造需求進行調整。

en.title: flyadeal launches livery design competition to celebrate 50th aircraft
en.summary: flyadeal invites public to design livery for its 50th aircraft; winner gets tickets and stay
body: Saudi low-cost carrier flyadeal is inviting the public to help design the livery for its 50th aircraft, launching a competition that offers a round-trip ticket for two, a three-night stay, and the chance to see a winning design flown on one of its planes.

The competition, open through flyadeal's dedicated site, asks participants to create an original aircraft livery concept using the airline's brand guidelines. According to flyadeal, its core color palette includes flyadeal Purple, flyadeal Lime, white, blue, sky, and pink.

flyadeal said that entries will be judged on originality, visual appeal, brand relevance, and feasibility, with the airline's judging panel making the final decision. The airline also said it may adapt the winning design to meet operational, safety, or manufacturing requirements before it is applied to the aircraft.

zh.title: 中國國際航空 A321 B-6605 桃園機場觀測抵達
zh.summary: 中國國際航空 A321 B-6605；桃園機場觀測抵達；2026-08-11
body: 本站監測系統觀測到一架中國國際航空所屬的空中巴士 A321 航空器，註冊號 B-6605，於臺灣桃園國際機場出現抵達訊號。公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，該航空器的 ICAO hex 為 7805c4，呼號為 CCA190，營運者 ICAO 為 CCA、IATA 為 CA，營運者中文名稱為中國國際航空，所屬國家或地區為中國。

觀測紀錄指出，本次事件的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 confirmed_by_primary_only。首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-11T12:32:14Z，確認抵達時間為 2026-08-11T13:57:46Z，抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground，有效觀測筆數為 2。
機場資訊方面，觀測資料記載機場 ICAO 為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。航空器 ICAO 機型為 A321，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A321。事件 ID 為 fw-e525367c412188aa，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。
統計說明欄位註明「系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計」，因此本站無法就此次觀測提供長期比較基準，亦不對該組合的罕見程度作出判斷。本報導僅呈現觀測系統所記錄的事實，不推測航班的出發地、目的地、飛航目的或任何營運計畫。
本次觀測屬於單一抵達事件的紀錄，本站不對該航班是否執行包機、客運、貨運、維護調度或外交任務等性質作出任何認定。所有內容均以公開 ADS-B 觀測資料為依據，未經機場或航空公司證實。

en.title: Air China Airbus A321 B-6605 Observed Arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan Int'l Airport
en.summary: Air China A321 B-6605; Taoyuan Airport observed arrival; 2026-08-11
body: The site's monitoring system observed an Airbus A321 aircraft registered B-6605, operated by Air China, arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. Public ADS-B observation data records the aircraft's ICAO hex as 7805c4, callsign as CCA190, operator ICAO as CCA, operator IATA as CA, operator name as Air China, operator Chinese name as 中國國際航空, and the operator's country or region as China.

The observation states that the primary data source is Airplanes.live, the secondary data source is ADSB.lol, and the cross-confirmation status is confirmed_by_primary_only. The first valid observation time is 2026-08-11T12:32:14Z, the confirmed arrival time is 2026-08-11T13:57:46Z, the arrival determination is confirmed_arrival, the confirmation basis is that the aircraft was within the airport geofence and alt_baro indicated ground, and the number of valid observation records is 2.

Regarding airport information, the observation data records the airport ICAO as RCTP and the airport name as Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The aircraft ICAO type is A321, and the model display name is Airbus A321. The event ID is fw-e525367c412188aa, and the data type is public ADS-B observation.

The statistics note states that the system's observation history is still accumulating and there is no comparable long-term statistical data available. Therefore, the site cannot provide a long-term comparison baseline for this observation, nor does it make any judgment on the rarity of this combination. This report only presents the facts recorded by the observation system and does not speculate on the flight's origin, destination, purpose, or any operational plan.

This observation is a record of a single arrival event. The site does not make any determination as to whether the flight operated as a charter, passenger, cargo, maintenance positioning, or diplomatic mission. All content is based solely on public ADS-B observation data and has not been confirmed by the airport or the airline.
